scope: Streamed snapshot-wide validation before staged generation completion
coverage: Duplicate resource, Pod UID/name, Node ID/name and controller-map keys
Canonical IPv6 underlay and WireGuard identity uniqueness
Nested IPv4 and IPv6 CIDR overlap in either record order
Custom instances preceding definitions, missing definitions and kind/version/scope mismatches
Invalid CRD storage count and duplicate definitions
No end callback before successful snapshot-wide validation
remaining: Staged application file materialization with durable Pod publication reload
Artifact digest verification and restore intent
Production WAL recovery and automatic compaction
